key.name: background-color
key.description: Base RGB color of the floating top bar.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage of the floating top bar on the desktop.

key.name: overview-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage of the floating top bar while Overview is open.

key.name: border-color
key.description: RGBA color used for the inset border around the floating top bar.

key.name: border-thickness
key.description: Inset border thickness in pixels (0 disables the border).

key.name: text-color
key.summary: Top bar text and icon color
key.description: Foreground RGBA color for text and icons on the top bar.

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the floating top bar in pixels.

key.name: panel-height
key.description: Locked height of the floating top bar in pixels.

key.name: margin-vertical
key.description: Top and bottom margin around the floating top bar in pixels.

key.name: margin-horizontal
key.description: Left and right margin around the floating top bar in pixels.

key.name: show-volume-percentage
key.description: Display inline volume percentage next to the volume icon.

key.name: show-wifi-percentage
key.description: Display inline Wi-Fi signal strength next to the Wi-Fi icon.

key.name: show-bluetooth-percentage
key.description: Display inline battery percentage for connected Bluetooth peripherals.
